checks.name: MISSING_REQUIRED_OUTPUT_FIELD
checks.definition: The agent produces an output that omits one or more contractually required output fields.
checks.when_to_use: Use when an output completely omits or leaves blank a field required by the agent's contract.
checks.when_not_to_use: Do not use when all required fields are present but contain inaccurate or malformed content.
